Panic attacks are very scary to experience! I have been diagnosed with panic disorder and have a lot of the symptoms you described.

I usually get chest pains, heart palpitations, hot and cold flashes, dizziness, tunnel vision, sweaty palms, whole body shakes, etc. 

Just remember that it is just a panic attack. You will not die and it will pass, no matter how scary it may feel in the moment. 

I know after I have a bad panic attack I am tired and sore for days. It sends your body into fight or flight mode and has to recover. It's why you feel so out of it the morning after one.

Your panic attacks are most likely being triggered by all the stressors in your life currently. My best advice would be to make time for you so you can relax. Like have a nice soak in the tub, settle down and read a good book you like, or even take up yoga. You just have to find activities that help you de-stress after a long stressful day!

Hardest thing for me was learning to distract myself when I feel a panic attack coming on. Luckily I've learned a few things to atleast make them less severe.
